title: Kelley Completes First Semester at MECA
paragraphs: Monomoy Regional High School 2020 graduate Abigail Kelley is shown holding the Guild of Harwich Artist’s 2020 Art Scholarship award of $1000. Abby received her $1000 check after successfully completing her first semester at the Maine College of Art.
excerpt: Monomoy Regional High School 2019 graduate Abigail Kelley is shown holding the Guild of Harwich Artist’s 2019 Art Scholarship award of $1000. Abby received her $1000 check after successfully completing her first semester at the Maine College of Art.
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder February 6, 2021

Monomoy Regional High School 2020 graduate Abigail Kelley is shown holding the Guild of Harwich Artist’s 2020 Art Scholarship award of $1000. Abby received her $1000 check after successfully completing her first semester at the Maine College of Art.

Posted in WHAT'S NEW
Tagged Maine College of Art, scholarship
